newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB climbs as bid talk lifts sector.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB climbs as bid talk lifts sector.

text.p: Shares in Lloyds TSB Group Plc rose in active trade on Tuesday as a strong banking sector benefited from talk of rationalisation.
The shares gained 18-1/2p to 628p in volume of over 12 million shares, making it the most active FTSE 100 stock.
"As soon as we see buyers in one stock in the sector the market makers put the others up as well, to compensate for the short positions," said one senior trader.
Elsewhere, National Westminster Plc was up 38p to 821-1/2p, Standard Chartered Plc rose 23-1/2p to 897-1/2p and Royal Bank of Scotland was up 15-1/2p to 598-1/2p by 1139 GMT.
NatWest and Royal Bank were at the centre of bid hopes on Tuesday which sparked initial gains.
"The sector is back in vogue," said one senior dealer. "There is lots of comment around on possible bids or mergers so it is understandable that this is where the money is pouring in."
